games.name: Linglox
games.desc:
PLAYING LINGO BEFORE PLAYING THIS IS RECOMMENDED HEAVILY
Find it just by searching lingothegame. The first result is the official website!

Linglox, you're set in a large world, able to roam around and solve all of the word puzzle objects called "Prompts". You're capable of finding alternative answers to Prompts throughout your gameplay, be careful! With over 10000+ Prompts to solve and 100+ Prompt colors, you're going to climb your way up to the title of a mastermind.

To solve a Prompt, type in the correct answer! The color and height of the block matter. 

Inspired by: Brenton Wildes' "Lingo I & II" and Arvi Teikari's "Baba Is You"

Created by: Many People...
Artwork credits: Moon, Croutons and Ange for badge icons and loading screens, they're awesome, go check them out (@._moon_moon_.), (@croutons0292), (@cosmoshining)! 
Check the art gallery for the community's art!

games.name: [10000] Ultimate Obby 2.0
games.desc:
before you ask, the game autosaves!

Are you willing to beat the ultimate parkour-filled adventure obstacle course spanning 10000 stages? Ultimate Obby 2.0 is a whole journey across many different areas from the nearby Forgotten Pillars towards the great Tripyramids all the way to the Lost Void. Beware of several different obstacle types the game will present to you obbyists ranging from regular old school lava to reverse phantoms. 

The game starts off as easy and chill like Mega Fun Obby. However, this experience will ultimately get more challenging later on. Progressing further in this obstacle course requires patience and some skill as you will encounter newer types of levels and hazards. Think this is an easy adventure? By level 7823, those thoughts will be long gone...

10000 levels. One Grande Finale. One dog. Good luck on your journey.

This game has been inspired from "Mega Fun Obby", "Longest Obby in ROBLOX" as well as references from "Eternal Towers of Hell".

games.name: STARBASE
games.desc:
Deep Space Update!
- Confront New Bosses in Deep Space!
- New Asteroid Belt!
- Explore Procedural Dungeon Secrets

Discover the expanse of the galaxy with over 200 ships across a huge procedurally generated solar system with fully explorable planets. 

Inspired by Space Affliction. 

Customize, and command colossal colonies or spawling space stations with a modular building system. 

Coordinate with friends to man massive multicrew spaceships featuring fully detailed interiors ranging from humble shuttles to gargantuan space battle ships and aircraft carriers. 

Master physics-based space combat in space fighter jet dogfights or massive warship battles. 

Graphics level 9-10 recommended. Private server owners can use commands ('@commands' to list) and admin ships in their private servers but do not earn any exp.

games.name: Azure Mines
games.desc:
You're in charge of restoring an old mining facility back to its former glory. 

Use the ore you uncover in the Azure Mines to rebuild your base. In this unique tycoon & mining game hybrid, all of your progress saves and loads automatically. Featuring responsive Xbox controls, this lightweight game ensures a smooth experience regardless of where you're playing it.

Massive randomly-generated caves, tons of detailed hand-designed ore, a unique tycoon element, a robust building system and an integrated level progression sets Azure Mines far apart from previous mining games on Roblox. See for yourself!

[Open Source] Want to make your own game like this? Use the Infinite Mining Game Kit to get started in minutes! No scripting knowledge required. https://www.roblox.com/library/4920625917/Infinite-Mining-Game-Kit-by-berezaa
